column1: # THE UPPER WING of the valuation cycle ABOUT ITS OWN 20-YEAR MEAN (PLAN item 25): the record's
# manias as the model can read them.  Level = log CAPE minus an EWMA of itself with a 20-year time
# constant (the model's `gapMean` reference on log(price / fundamental)); the first 20 years of the
# monthly series (1881-1900) are burn-in for the reference and excluded from w1901.
#   shareAboveNN / shareBelowNN   share of months with the level above +0.NN / below -0.NN
#   sdLevel, maxLevel, minLevel   the level's spread and extremes in the window
#   excursionsPerCentury          distinct spells above +0.5 (a spell ends under +0.25), per century
#   excursionYearsMedian          the median spell's years above +0.25
#   shareAbove50BootSd / shareBelow50BootSd   the share's sampling sd by a moving-block bootstrap of the level
#                                 series (20-year blocks, 4000 resamples, seed 20260915); relative to the share,
#   peak rows                     the named peaks' levels and dates
# Source: Shiller ie_data.xls (2023-09-17 vintage; column 12, CAPE), monthly.  Measured 2026-09-15.
# WHAT IT SETTLES: the record spends 27% of its months above +0.3 and 7.6% above +0.5, with four
# Nasdaq recipe reads 12% / 2.5% and 0.8 spells a century, the S&P default 2.8% / 0.2% and 0.1:
# the model's manias are too rare by four times on the Nasdaq and thirty on the S&P.
